research_questions.RQ_A: Compare outcomes and fault propagation/observability across selected CTL, BUF, MEM and DAT logical RTL state bits under a single XOR-deposit upset.
research_questions.RQ_B: For the SAME executed scenario and raw trace, count added observable events at L1 vs L0 and L2 vs L1; do not interpret testbench checkpoints as on-chip detectors.

design.analysis_unit: one unique scenario_id = one selected image x target x frozen bit/time tuple
design.repeated_runs: repeats test reproducibility, not independent population samples

fault_model.event: one RTL sequential state-bit XOR deposit per inference
fault_model.persistence: state remains changed until natural overwrite/transition
fault_model.baseline: same P0 RTL SHA256, frozen weights, selected input, time contract and bit-exact golden
fault_model.excludes: no permanent stuck-at, no physical post-route FF/radiation distribution

observation_levels.L2: L1 OR observed_pool1_mismatch OR observed_pool2_mismatch OR other predeclared stage checkpoint mismatch
observation_levels.E3: out-of-band value-aware consumer acceptance/control-decision proof; never on-chip error detection

stage_measurement.checkpoint_units: compare against fault-free golden for the same image and stage, only when the instrumented checkpoint is actually available
stage_measurement.first_bad_stage: record earliest proven mismatch; NOT_OBSERVED otherwise
stage_measurement.numeric_masking: must independently establish whether arithmetic output changed; cannot infer from final match or consumer acceptance alone

paired_comparisons.members: exactly two distinct frozen configurations A and B (not repeat executions)
paired_comparisons.L1_increment: count(L1==1 AND L0==0) only when both are evaluable for same scenario_id
paired_comparisons.L2_increment: count(L2==1 AND L1==0) only when both are evaluable for same scenario_id
paired_comparisons.missing_policy: never treat NOT_OBSERVED, NOT_APPLICABLE or INCONCLUSIVE as zero

missing_value_policy.failed_runner_or_invalid_log: INVALID_EVIDENCE; do not classify as RTL fault outcome
missing_value_policy.timeout_validated_noncompletion: NONCOMPLETION requires locked, documented watchdog timeout; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
missing_value_policy.partial_campaign: report completed prefix, missing IDs, and do not silently rescale counts to 400

nonexposure_policy.valid_nonexposed_requires: explicit write/inject/overwrite/read/consumer chronology and reviewer decision

metrics.rates: descriptive fractions conditioned on selected directed sample; do not generalize to physical SEU probability
metrics.statistical_independence: 40 directed IMG0000 evidence and V4d repeats are NOT added as independent Full400 observations

execution_integrity.frozen_inputs: no RTL P0/TB/weights/plan mutation, check source hashes before/after each run
execution_integrity.atomic_checkpoint: commit only after validated mechanism/outcome and log hash
execution_integrity.resume: fail closed on orphan/partial/duplicate/altered prior logs; never silently repair
execution_integrity.campaign_approval: separate explicit independent G0-G7 release after dedicated Full400-runner qualification
execution_integrity.timeout_and_errors: simulation/runtime infrastructure errors never counted as design NONCOMPLETION
